lines: I have pulled mean things from dark water. Tonight was louder, that is all.
I followed the safest current I could find. Tonight, that current was back here.
I followed the sound of home like a line pulled tight.
Dark water is honest compared to a dark road with raiders near it.
I came back cold, winded, and happy to complain about both.
The night tried to pull me under. I kept my head up.
I have lost catches before. I am glad I was not the catch this time.
The door felt like a dock after bad weather.
When danger came close, nobody had time to sound brave first.
You learn a lot about a village when everyone hears the bell at once.
